# Indriya

> Indriya is a luxury Indian jewellery brand; this site is an educational demo guide to Varalakshmi Vratham gold jewellery and temple jewellery traditions, written by Aryan Mehta and published 26 October 2026.

This site explains temple jewellery motifs (Lakshmi, peacock, lotus), styling for South Indian bridal and festive occasions, and practical jewellery care. It is a student assignment demo: it makes no claims about product availability, pricing, purity, or certifications. For current product details, visit the linked Indriya collection pages.

## Pages

- [Varalakshmi Vratham Gold Jewellery](/varalakshmi-vratham-gold-jewellery): Landing guide with festive jewellery categories, craftsmanship notes, and FAQs.
- [Temple Jewellery Guide](/temple-jewellery-guide): Educational article on temple jewellery history, motifs, styling, and care.
- [Contact](/contact): Student assignment contact; official purchase enquiries belong with Indriya.
- [About](/about): Aryan Mehta, SYBBA Marketing Major; research method and editorial standards.
- [Press & Media](/press): Source-linked references about the jewellery brand.
